$comment: The ed25519 keys a cmux-next web update pointer may be signed with (plans/cmux-next/web-ota.md). The app trusts only these; scripts/cmux-next/web-ota-pointer.py verify reads the same file in CI. id is the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte key. The private key of each is the CMUX_WEB_OTA_SIGNING_KEY secret of the artifacts environment. To rotate: add the new key here, ship it in a nightly, then switch the secret and remove the old key.
